name: CoNLL-2014 Shared Task on Grammatical Error Correction
description: Hwee Tou Ng, Siew Mei Wu, Ted Briscoe, Christian Hadiwinoto, Raymond Hendy Susanto, Christopher Bryant. Proceedings of the Eighteenth Conference on Computational Natural Language Learning: Shared Task. 2014.
notes: Widely used GEC benchmark with a single-reference M2-style evaluation; commonly reported with F0.5. Dataset is modest in size and drawn from learner essays (educational domain). Risk of contamination exists if models have been trained on overlapping corpora; multiple-correction variability and evaluation sensitivity to edit granularity are known caveats.
